summary.zh-Hans: 墨西哥城美术宫于1934年开放，外立面使用白色大理石。建筑外部的新艺术风格与内部的装饰艺术风格相互映照。
summary.en: Mexico City’s Palacio de Bellas Artes opened in 1934 and has a white-marble facade. Its Art Nouveau exterior contrasts with an Art Deco interior.

names.zh-Hans: 查普尔特佩克森林公园

summary.zh-Hans: 查普尔特佩克是墨西哥城的城市森林，分为四个区域。这里把绿地与文化场馆汇集在同一片城市空间。
summary.en: Chapultepec is an urban forest in Mexico City divided into four sections. It brings green spaces and cultural venues together within the city.

summary.zh-Hans: 篮子塔可是墨西哥城街头常见的塔可。常见馅料包括土豆、香肠、猪皮和炒豆泥，通常提前做好后带去售卖。
summary.en: Tacos de canasta are a Mexico City street food, usually prepared before being taken out to sell. Fillings can include potatoes, sausage, pork rind and refried beans.

summary.zh-Hans: 塔马尔以玉米面团为基础，可加入不同馅料，用玉米苞叶或芭蕉叶等包裹，常以蒸汽蒸熟。墨西哥城街头可见售卖塔马尔的摊点。
summary.en: Tamales use corn dough with varied fillings, wrapped in leaves such as corn husks or banana leaves and commonly steamed. They are sold by street vendors in Mexico City.
